note: POST-SANITY-CHECK PROTOCOL AMENDMENT, PRE-BLIND FINAL FREEZE (2026-09-17 16:20). Supersedes the earlier 2026-09-17 13:20 freeze (SELF_ONLY=accept, preserved read-only at configs/pre_amendment/verifier_config.json), which was found to collapse exactly to M2 on validation (0/427 differences -- see results/validation/pre_amendment/m2_vs_m3_frozen_sanity.json) and was therefore excluded as not genuinely source-aware. Re-ran the full validation pipeline from scratch (fresh 427-image draft regeneration, fresh M0-M3 scoring) and selected SELF_ONLY=exact after confirming it is behaviorally distinguishable from M2 (results/validation/m2_vs_m3_frozen_sanity.json: 1/427 images differ). m0_no_verification.description: No brand-evidence gate. accepted_brands = candidate_brands always. Still passes through the shared final summary-consistency audit and finalize().

m1_external_ocr_only.description: Brand DECISION stage only. Reuses production pipeline.anchor_gate(brand, product, summary, ocr_text, vlm_ocr='') unmodified. Real vlm_ocr is still used by shared finalize() downstream -- M1 is 'external-OCR-only brand verification', not an OCR-only pipeline.

m2_simple_fusion.description: Current PRODUCTION verification behavior. Reuses pipeline.anchor_gate(brand, product, summary, ocr_text, vlm_ocr) unmodified, with the real vlm_ocr. Equal-trust OR-fusion of external OCR and VLM self-transcription; no source distinction.

m3_source_aware.description: Source-aware verification. Computes ext_match and self_match SEPARATELY (never concatenates external_ocr+vlm_ocr before matching) then classifies a support state before applying a policy.
m3_source_aware.conflict_state_reason: No operational definition of CONFLICT exists in current code or data (no region attribution, no brand lexicon/NER, no spatial evidence). Per explicit instruction, CONFLICT is deliberately excluded from the first legitimate benchmark. If introduced later it must be separately justified and validated, not merely re-added because an earlier planning document mentioned it.

matcher.note: Both calls use the SAME imported pipeline.contains() fuzzy matcher as M1/M2, applied separately per source instead of on a concatenated haystack. This keeps M2 vs M3 a controlled comparison of FUSION POLICY, not of matcher quality.

match_type_diagnostic.note: Optional per instructions -- only implement if actually needed by the frozen SELF_ONLY policy or for diagnostics. Placeholder values if enabled: exact | accent_normalized | alnum | fuzzy | word_fuzzy | none. Not a confidence score -- pipeline.contains() returns bool only, no calibrated confidence exists anywhere in the codebase.

m3_source_aware.policy_selection_dataset: data/processed/val.jsonl (427 images) -- the ORIGINAL LoRA validation split, reused here as the verifier-policy validation set per BENCHMARK_EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md section 3.1. Fixed drafts regenerated FRESH for the protocol amendment (not reusing the pre-amendment drafts) -- see artifacts/fixed_drafts/validation/fixed_drafts_validation_meta.json.
m3_source_aware.policy_selection_procedure: PROTOCOL AMENDMENT 2026-09-17: SELF_ONLY='accept' excluded up front (proven equivalent to M2 in the pre-amendment sanity check). Ran M3 twice on the same fresh 427-image validation fixed drafts: SELF_ONLY='reject' (Policy A) vs SELF_ONLY='exact' (Policy B -- accept only when pipeline.contains_exact(vlm_ocr, candidate) is True; external OCR not consulted for this state). Scored via scripts/score_entities.py --expected-count 427 against artifacts/fixed_drafts/validation/val_gt_derived.csv.

policy_selection_result.reason: Primary criterion (declared before comparison): higher Brand F1. exact=0.5792 > reject=0.5714, not a tie, so no UBR/CBR tie-break needed. Note: reject's metrics are numerically identical to M1's (SELF_ONLY=reject makes M3's decision logic equivalent to accept-iff-ext_match, i.e. M1) -- expected internal-consistency check.

delta_vs_m2.note: Selected M3 does NOT beat M2 on Brand F1/UBR/CBR on this validation split -- reported as-is, not manipulated. See results/validation/m2_vs_m3_frozen_sanity.json for the full accepted/released-brand diff (1/427 images) proving this is NOT a collapse to M2.
